metadata.rng: NumPy Generator(PCG64), SeedSequence.spawn(1 baseline + one per sorted canonical site)
metadata.draw_rule: Each eligible bin: choose k=min(low sites, mid-high sites) separately without replacement; average site-mean record IQR; ΔEV=mid-high−low
metadata.phase_rule: Arithmetic mean of eligible bin ΔEV in each predefined phase, per iteration; unavailable if no eligible bin
metadata.canonical_site_note: Use existing v5 canonical site mapping. Pooled pCO2 is not in the latitude IQR sheets; legacy site aliases within one operational record count as one canonical site.
